decision: Electric Glass (Option 1) approved as the C360 revamp design direction
polish: nav: active tab = whisper-faint purple wash (#F6EFFF bg, #E6DCFF border), ink text and icon, NO dot, no bold purple anywhere in the tab row
relationship graph: orthogonal ownership tree (current GraphTab direction, modernized); no curvy hub-and-spoke
chat streaming: word-by-word at ~60ms, each word slides in (opacity + 4px rise + blur clear, 340ms ease-out); no chunk jumps
graph: connectors are organic bezier curves measured from real node positions, floating INTO the focused relationship, with glowing particles traveling down the flow; generalizes to any entity count
workroom: ONE immersive glass canvas, no divided rail; stage = hairline progress under the top bar + quiet stage word; confirmed changes FLY to a floating glass manifest stack top-right
no popups: all decision states live in a dark-glass dynamic ISLAND at the bottom of the room morphing proposal -> confirm(token) -> liquid loader -> landed
landing: NO sparklines / mini-meter spines on clients or KPI cells (hard rule)
client header: identity is its own floating glass HERO panel (bloom + oversized > watermark + specular); only the slim icon tab rail stays sticky

graph final: EDGED metro routes (orthogonal segments, 10px soft corners), 1.5px gradient stroke at .6 opacity, ONE small slow particle per route at .45 - subtle, not prominent; measured from node positions (any entity count) Corner radius 4px (2026-08-31: 10px read too curvy).

app top bar: clean full-width glass bar, NO rounded panel, NO gradient hairlines (Fabian: gradient spines 'look shit'); gradient ink is reserved for functional moments only (workroom progress, island glow, graph route stroke)

Client workspace nav lives IN the app header, truly centered (2026-08-31, supersedes the below-hero floating capsule): the icon-capsule tab nav is absolutely centered in the topbar (left:50% translate(-50%,-50%)), visible only on the client view (body.on-client), compact recipe (padding 3px 5px, itab 6px 9px, 14px icons, capsule 41px inside the 52px bar), soft white .55 fill + hairline + inner rim, NO heavy drop shadow inside the glass bar. Landing header stays clean - brand left, live dot / cmdk / avatar right. TRANSITION: the nav never pops - display stays block; enter = capsule fades + settles from scale(.94)/-46% with .12s intent delay, tabs cascade in at 30ms stagger via ANIMATION-delays (navtabin keyframes), NEVER transition-delays - a transition-delay on the tabs poisons every later interactive state change (clicking a tab waited up to .32s before its wash/label moved, reading as 'moves back then jumps'); exit = immediate soft fade, no delay. prefers-reduced-motion kills all of it.
graph endpoints: connectors start 2px BELOW the source node and stop 2px ABOVE the target - a line never enters a box
graph borrower card: quiet - white surface, 1px lavender (#E6DCFF) border, standard card shadow; NO purple glow, NO gradient fill
worklist rows: hover is lift + shadow only - NO inset purple accent bar (reads as a spine)

page ground carries NO purple bloom - the top-right violet radial (body + ambient drift) is removed; ambient = one quiet teal bloom bottom-left only. Purple blooms live only INSIDE glass panels (hero, workroom, drawer), never on the page itself

ground = APPLE CANVAS #F5F5F7 (near-neutral whisper-cool, the macOS/apple.com light ground - NOT pure white, which kills glass) with #FFFFFF radial at top; surfaces #F0F0F2, hairlines #E8E8ED (Apple separators); content glass brightened to white .72-.74 so frosted cards float on the grey; warm greys remain banned

MATERIAL SPLIT (iOS liquid glass, final): CONTENT IS SOLID - cards, rows, feed, opps, tree nodes, anchors, thread cards are opaque #fff with hairline border + soft shadow (0 1px 2px .03 / 0 10px 28px -14px .1); translucent data cards read muddy and are banned. CHROME IS LENS GLASS - top bar, hero, nav capsule, workroom, drawer, chat, cmdk, island, manifest chips: white .5-.6 + blur 34-40 + saturate 1.8-1.9, dark outer hairline rgba(0,0,0,.05-.06), LENS RIM = inset 0 1px 1px white .95 + inset 0 -1px 1px white .35 + inset 0 0 0 1px white .28, deep soft drop shadow. Active tab pill gets segmented-control depth (0 1px 4px .08 + inset top light)

workroom purple diet: banker bubble = INK glass (rgba(24,23,30,.92) + gloss), never solid purple; confirmed delta = white with quiet green hairline (#D8ECDF), never purple wash; room blooms at .045/.035; stage word grey. In the room, purple = Confirm/Execute button + selected chip wash + progress hairline + the mark, nothing else
workroom thread: 20px gap, delta cards padded 14x18 with own margins - arrivals never crowd the chat

workroom motion: arrivals use wk-in (12px rise + .965 scale with a whisper of overshoot, 500-550ms settle); delta content cascades in (label -> value -> advisory -> actions, 70ms steps); manifest chips land with a pop (scale .88 -> 1.02 -> 1)

COMMIT MOMENTS ARE INK, NEVER VIOLET (Fabian hard call): Confirm/primary buttons = ink glass (#141318 w/ gloss, hover black); the island's Execute = WHITE button on the dark sheet; the fly-to-manifest chip = white w/ neutral shadow (no violet glow); activity 'hot' marker = ink ring; island glow neutral. Violet fill on any add/commit trigger is banned - purple stays identity (mark, units, wash, progress), never the trigger
workroom bubbles are LIGHT: banker = cool grey #E9EBF2 with ink text (alignment carries the role), agent = white bordered; no dark bubbles

workroom focus model: the past RECEDES - thread has a top fade mask, everything but the last two items dims to 45% (hover restores), an 'earlier steps' glass hint floats below the top bar when history exists (click scrolls up; scrolling up reveals full opacity)

WORKROOM IS A GUIDED RITUAL: opens with the agent greeting ('Hey <user> - you're working on <client>, let me look up eligible product packages'), a shimmer load-chip (goo mark + shimmering bars, in-thread), selectable package cards (ineligible ones visible but disabled), then a package brief (facilities/covenants/windows) with facility chips; input + suggestions sleep until the brief lands
workroom shows ONE live exchange: every send starts a new step, prior steps collapse fully behind an '(n) earlier steps' chip (click expands/collapses); no visible scrollbar in the thread ever

workroom REACTS TO FREE INPUT: intent parser files commitment ($xM), pricing (SOFR+bps), maturity (yyyy-mm) and covenant (x.xx x) changes against the SELECTED facility with parsed values in the delta card, manifest title and proposed view; unparseable lines get an honest clarify with examples - never a canned response to the wrong ask

selecting a facility chip shows its detail card in the right lane; once anything is confirmed an Existing|Proposed glass switcher appears top-center - Proposed renders overridden values with 'was ...' strikethroughs; after execute the overrides MERGE into existing and the switcher retires
execute confirms IN THE CHAT: a new step with the agent summarizing exactly what landed on the package (values, was-amounts, plan hash); the island collapses, the room stays open on the confirmation

TYPE-ICON LANGUAGE: every credit object carries a subtle 24px rounded-square icon (13px 1.5-stroke, ink-3 on surface-2; purple-deep when selected) - revolver (cycle), term loan (calendar), equipment (crate), covenant (shield-check), pricing (percent), maturity (clock), commitment (banknote), collateral (lock). Used on facility rows, delta card labels, detail card header, and manifest chips - one language everywhere including the committing lane
facility rows are UNIFORM: full-width compact rows (max 380px) stacked under the brief bubble - icon + name left, amount right-aligned bold; never variable-length pills
right lane rhythm: Existing|Proposed switcher sits centered DIRECTLY above the detail card (12px below it), detail card 16px above the manifest chips, chips 10px apart - nothing touches

REVIEW & EXECUTE LIVES IN THE CHAT (island retired): after a confirm, an appearing glass icon-chip pops into the thread ('n changes on the manifest · Review & execute'); clicking it pops open the flow card IN the thread (token + Cancel / ink Execute); execution runs inline (goo mark + crossfading status + shimmer bars as a thread item); the card dissolves and the agent posts the confirmation with actual deltas. Nothing floats over the composer, nothing near the input bar
thread clearance: when the earlier-steps chip is visible the thread pads to 58px top (animated) so bubbles never crowd the chip

NO Existing|Proposed switcher: the detail card IS the state - committed deltas land on it inline (new value + 'was ...' strikethrough, header gains '· proposed'); after execute they merge silently. Nothing flies into the side lane - manifest chips pop in place
buttons are PLAIN ink pills: #141318, radius 999, no gloss gradient, no glow shadow (gloss+glow reads vibecoded); secondary = quiet grey pill
the execute loader is a structured .flowload: goo mark and status stack vertically centered (0px delta), full-width shimmer bars beneath - never inline-styled improvisation

THE MORPH FINALE: when execution lands, the flow card morphs into a RESULT CHIP in the live exchange - glass pill segmented by icons: [package] Product Package · <client> | [banknote] n loans updated | [shield] n covenants added | green check - followed by the agent's confirmation in the same step (the finale never rolls into a collapsed step)

workroom bar is ONE SLIM LINE: purple mark + a single word ('Modification') left, FOUR MICRO-DOTS for the stage right (5px, ink when passed, current scaled 1.5x with a soft ring, titles on hover), close x. NO lockup (the app bar has the brand), NO package pill (the greeting and lane carry it), NO stage word, NO progress bar

app header is MINIMAL: the original > mark alone carries the brand (no 'accenture' wordmark, no divider) + 'Credit 360' + spacer + live dot (tooltip 'Live · nCino + AFS') + cmd-K chip + avatar; 52px slim glass bar. The full 'accenture / Commercial Credit 360 / Live · nCino + AFS' spelled-out header is retired

MARK CENSUS (final): the original > appears ONLY at - app header brand, hero watermark, empty-state watermark, workroom bar, chat FAB + send + thinking, and the breathing loading marks. NEVER in eyebrows/kickers (Worklist, date line, client section labels - all bare text now), never as an action-row or cmdk icon (those use the typed icon language / a search glyph). One brand mark per viewport, plus watermarks and the molten moments

FOCUS RINGS ARE INK: global :focus-visible = 2px rgba(20,19,24,.65) (accessibility ring stays VISIBLE - the backlog a11y item - but never purple); inputs inside pill containers (chat bar, workroom composer, cmdk) suppress the inner outline and the PILL takes focus via :focus-within (darker hairline + soft 3px ink ring). Scripted refocus never flashes purple

AUDIT TRAIL / TIMELINE (porcelain): 1px connecting line that FADES at both ends (gradient), 9px white dots with a rgba(0,0,0,.22) hairline ring and a 3.5px white halo so the line passes BEHIND every dot; the latest ('hot') entry = solid ink dot with an extra 7px soft aura; dots fill ink on row hover; 24px entry spacing; entries cascade in (fadeup, 70ms stagger) when the pane opens

CLIENT ACTIONS LIVE IN THE > FAB (drawer + hero button retired): clicking the FAB fans a QUARTER-CIRCLE of five 40px glass satellites out of the mark (chat at top, then modification, renewal, annual review, covenant review at the horizontal) - radius 96px, staggered 28ms spring, labels appear as small glass tags to the LEFT on hover; the mark rotates 90deg while open; outside click / Esc collapses; chat opens from the arc; modification routes to the workroom (navigating to the client first if needed)
the FAB is CONTEXT-AWARE: on the landing it opens the assist chat directly (no arc - actions make no sense without a client); on a client view it fans the full action arc (chat + 4 actions)
workroom thread air: 30px between exchanges, 24px between bubbles within an exchange

bubble identity: every workroom bubble carries a data-who and a tiny glass identity chip ('YOU' right-corner / 'AGENT' left-corner, 9px caps, glass pill) that fades in 21px ABOVE the bubble on hover - no layout shift, roles never ambiguous
FAB open state: the mark rotates 180deg to point LEFT (<) INTO the fanned arc - never down

FAB arc narrates through ONE anchored chip, never floating labels: satellites are unlabeled icons on a 118px radius (46px between centers); a single glass chip sits CENTERED beneath the FAB (left:50% translateX(-50%), top calc(100%+9px), 10px uppercase, blur 20 saturate 1.6) reading 'Client actions' at rest and the hovered satellite's action on hover. FAB position right:44 bottom:52 so the chip has air on every side. Labels stay one or two words (Modification, Renewal, Annual review, Covenant review, Assist) so the centered chip never spills the viewport. Per-satellite floating labels are banned (2026-08-31).

Workroom thread breathing room: .wk-thread gap 38px, .wk-step gap 32px. Any decoration hung above a bubble (identity chip at -21px) must be smaller than the step gap so it can never touch the element above (2026-08-31).

Chat lifecycle: the FAB YIELDS while the assist is open (opacity 0, scale .6, pointer-events none) - never two controls in the corner. The panel sits exactly where the FAB was (right:44 bottom:52) so it reads as the mark morphing into the conversation. Panel header carries two quiet ghost controls (minimize dash + close X, 24px, ink-3, hover wash). Minimize folds the panel into a compact glass 'Assist' pill holding the same spot (conversation kept); clicking the pill restores. Close dismisses everything and the FAB returns (2026-08-31).

Empty states CENTER in their card, never hug the top: .empty is a full-height flex column (justify-content:center) and .card:has(> .empty) is a flex column, so a grid-stretched card centers the watermark + title + body at its true middle (2026-08-31, 'No projections' card was 73px high).

CONTINUITY (2026-08-31): nothing teleports. Worklist row -> client: the client NAME physically flies from the row into the hero (fixed ghost, 14.5px->25px font-size + letter-spacing morph, .52s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); body.flying suppresses viewin so the ghost carries ALL motion; hero name hidden during flight, fades back on landing). Workroom: a white glass seed circle (340px, soft violet bloom shadow, NO backdrop-filter so Safari-safe) ripples out of the exact arc button pressed, timed with the room's opacity entrance.

AGENT PRESENCE (2026-08-31): ONE whisper, once per session - after ~3.2s idle on the landing, the FAB breathes twice (scale 1.05 + soft violet bloom, 2.6s cycles) and a glass whisper chip floats up off the mark ('Hartwell renewal window · 45 days. Open the client?', ink text, purple mark icon, ghost dismiss). Click rides the name-flight into the client. Whisper yields to chat open. Never a badge, never a count, never more than one.

TACTILITY + LIGHT (2026-08-31): press physics on every control (:active scale .94-.99; arc satellites preserve their translate). The header capsule catches light - a 90px specular radial follows the cursor (::after, rgba(255,255,255,.55), hover-gated). Boot: briefing headline rises word by word (70ms stagger from 120ms). Client anchors materialize with a 45ms cascade on every view entry. All of it dies under prefers-reduced-motion. Copy rule: no em dashes in any UI copy.

ODOMETER (2026-08-31): a figure never swaps, it ROLLS. Changed digits become per-column strips (old over new, height 1em, overflow hidden) sliding up .6s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) with 45ms per-column stagger and a 1.3px blur pulse mid-roll; unchanged characters hold still. Requires tabular-nums on the container. Same-length values only; different lengths swap plain. Engine: odoRoll(el,newText) operates on the element's first text node, restores plain text after 1.1s.

WRITE-BACK THROUGH THE GLASS (2026-08-31): execute is theater with real numbers. During the liquid verify, the commitment delta is computed from the manifest (old vs new commitment) and the cockpit changes BEHIND the workroom blur: hero Total-exposure anchor, worklist amount, and exposure-table total all odo-roll to the new figure while the room is still open. When the glass lifts (closeRoom), a violet wash (rgba(161,0,255,.09) bg + .2 hairline, 1.7s settle) plays ONCE on each changed anchor, then clears. The wash is the only purple the write-back is allowed.

CMDK LENS (2026-08-31): the palette is a lens, not a popup. Open = body.lensed pushes topbar + active view into depth of field (blur 14px, saturate .92, scale .988, .45s) and blurs the FAB; the glass field itself rises .42s from scale .965 and the three result rows materialize at 60ms stagger. Backdrop dim only rgba(16,4,30,.10) - the DOF does the work. Escape snaps the world back. Reduced-motion kills the DOF entirely.

THE BOOK IS REAL (2026-08-31): every worklist row opens ITS client, never a template stuck on Hartwell. Hartwell is authored in the HTML and captured pristine at boot; Piedmont (grade 3, clean, $18.4M) and Meridian (grade 7, past due, breaches, empty opportunities) rebuild hero + all seven panes from a data map with the same classes. Rebuilt regions mean NO direct listeners inside them - goHome is event-delegated. The Hartwell-scripted workroom is gated on other clients (toast, no room). An executed exposure delta survives navigation (re-applied over the pristine restore). LESSON: an element in a rebuilt region must never carry a second direct listener that bypasses the shared handler's gate (actModify's direct openRoom bypassed the client gate).

WORKROOM SOUL (2026-08-31): (1) the agent SPEAKS, never pastes - agent bubble text nodes split into word spans that condense out of the glass (opacity+4px blur to clear, 26ms stagger; layout pre-settled so nothing reflows). (2) A proposed value ROLLS into the right lane from the old figure (odoRoll on the detail row, 'was' note beside it). (3) SUPERSEDED 2026-08-31: veil + sweep removed - the iridescent aura on the flow card / result dossier is execute's single light source. (4) The FAB idles ALIVE, refined 2026-08-31 ('trashy' v1 rejected): a CONTINUOUS slow breath, never a blink - ::after halo inset -3px, 14px/2px rgba(161,0,255,.13), opacity 0 to .55 to 0 over a 7s ease-in-out sinusoid. No opacity snaps, no big blooms, no scale. The whisper breathe is scale 1.02 max with a .16-alpha glow, 3.2s. Rule: the mark's life is felt, not seen.

FLIGHT LANDING (2026-08-31, root-caused twice): a shared-element morph must end as a crossfade-in-place (real element revealed at full opacity UNDER the ghost, ghost dissolves over it .16s). AND the suppressed view entry animation must be suppressed via a class ON THE VIEW that (a) OUTRANKS the .show rule (.view.noanim.show{animation:none} - .view.noanim alone loses the specificity tie to .view.show and silently does nothing) and (b) is removed only when the view next HIDES - removing it while visible flips animation none->viewin and RESTARTS the whole entry animation, which is the 'ms refresh' blip. Never suppress via a body-level class you remove at flight end.
PANE SWITCH CALM (2026-08-31): tab panes SETTLE, they never jump - panein = opacity + 3px rise on the settle curve (.34s), replacing the 8px viewin. Reserve bigger travel for view-level changes only.

PRECISION LIFE (2026-08-31): (1) the grade ring DRAWS itself on every client entry - reset to full offset, then 1s settle-curve transition to the grade value. (2) Meters fill from zero on pane entry (@keyframes from{width:0}, end state = inline width, .15s delay). (3) Hero depth: the watermark leans up to 6px/4px AGAINST the cursor over a 1.2s settle transition - depth, never a gimmick wobble. (4) cmdk filters live as you type; a quiet no-results row ('Nothing matches. Try a client or an action.') replaces silence. (5) Workroom bubbles settle with a .985 scale micro-pop. (6) The landing kicker shows the REAL date (client-side Date). All reduced-motion-safe.

THE RESULT DOSSIER (2026-08-31, FINAL after A/B with founder): execute's finale is a compact glass CARD that CONSTRUCTS itself - header (Product Package · Hartwell) lands, a hairline DRAWS across (scaleX 0 to 1), each actual change row materializes with its value right-aligned (~300ms apart, from the REAL manifest), second hairline, then '✓ Written to nCino · verification re-query passed' with the check popping last. THE LIGHT (approved form): the soft iridescent HALO - conic pastel spectrum (violet/blue/teal/amber/coral ~.3 alpha) behind the card, inset -4px, blur 14, opacity .38, the GRADIENT ANGLE rotating via @property --aang (9s linear; the box NEVER rotates - a spinning blurred rect paints a giant circle). Gated by .lit; breathes out ~5s after the card lands (1.4s fade). Execute's ONLY light, never on any other surface. REJECTED after trial: border BEAMS tracing the card edge (21st.dev border-beam) - founder verdict 'absolutely garbage' vs the halo; hard bright rainbow segments read as gamer RGB against Electric Glass. Iridescence here must be DIFFUSE (through frosted glass), never a crisp traveling line.

FINAL SWEEP (2026-08-31): (1) Toasts are GLASS WHISPERS - lens-glass pill with the purple mark (CSS mask of the official path), never an ink slab; rises on the spring curve. (2) cmdk is fully keyboard-driven: ArrowUp/Down move .sel through VISIBLE (unfiltered) rows, Enter fires the selection, alongside the live filter. (3) Empty-state watermarks BREATHE - opacity .04 to .08 over an 8s sinusoid; no surface in the product is fully dead. (4) The activity timeline SPINE draws itself top-down (.9s scaleY settle) while its dots cascade. (5) The header knows when content slides beneath it: body.scrolled (scrollY>8) adds a soft drop shadow to the glass bar, .4s eased both ways. All reduced-motion-safe.

LENS-GRADE EVERYWHERE (2026-08-31, final material pass): ALL glass chrome is cut from ONE sheet. Canonical recipe on every glass surface: white .55-.66 body, blur 28-38 by size (micro-chips 28, chips/satellites 28-30, bars 36, floating panels 38, workroom 30 as approved), saturate 1.75-1.9, DARK outer hairline rgba(0,0,0,.05-.06) - NEVER a white border (white borders make glass glow instead of reading as a cut edge; cmdk + chatpanel had this bug), and the TRIPLE inner rim (inset 0 1px 1px .95 / inset 0 -1px 1px .35 / inset 0 0 0 1px .28) on every surface. Census-verified: 15 glass surfaces, 14 at 3 rims; sole exception .arclbl (7px-radius micro-chip, one rim - a triple rim smears at that size). Expensive = zero recipe drift; the census check (count inset per backdrop-filter element) is the regression test for the port.

THE LANDING WEAVE (2026-08-31, post-freeze addendum, founder-requested): the filament weave from the truist-brain hero, contained and tuned for the light ground - 12 seeded cubic-bezier threads (violet family #5B2D90/#7B3FB0/#A100FF, lead thread CORE at .20 opacity, others .06-.14, widths .5-1.2px) in a 380px band behind the briefing headline reaching just past the KPI band top, double-fade mask (transparent top AND bottom), z0 behind content (page z1), each thread drifting on its own sine (amp 4-14, freq .05-.13, rAF transforms). Landing only; dies under prefers-reduced-motion; pointer-events none. This is identity TEXTURE like the hero watermark, not a spine - it is the one sanctioned use of ambient violet linework.
rejected: Large-title condensation (hero docking into the header on scroll) - REMOVED 2026-08-31: the header center belongs to the workspace nav capsule; a docking client title crowds it. The header carries brand + nav + controls, nothing else.

Third-party design systems (@astryxdesign/core + StyleX, proposed 2026-08-31): NOT installed. StyleX is a React compile-time styling engine - useless in the vanilla dummy, and churn for the port which has its own token system. astryxdesign is unvetted npm (same supply-chain posture as liquid-gooey). The coherence of the hand-tuned system IS the product; imported component aesthetics dilute it.

status as typography, never pill soup
glass on chrome only, solid ground under data
